source.name: HighBarV3
source.status: historical candidate; not installed or current

components.title: Factory replacement child assembly and native correlation
components.summary: Groups Count1 children by parent and actor, encodes a correlated replacement request through the appended engine callback, and converts only a decoded correlated committed result with valid native tags into Applied.

components.title: Engine-thread command drain and result projection
components.summary: Builds replacement children from queued live commands, polls native results during the engine-thread drain, projects terminal per-child dispatch events, then flushes those events through the normal frame delta producer.

flows.title: Decoded live child to post-poll frame delta

steps.description: Materialize one FactoryReplacementChild from the queued decoded live command, binding parent, child index/count, catalogue, authority, actor lifetime, definition and observed snapshot.
Reject invalid, expired, inconsistent or conflicting children and complete only an indexed full parent group.
Re-decode the canonical snapshot, bind operation sequence/request ID/digest and submit the replacement through FactoryReplacementApi.
Read the exact sequence/ID/digest result, decode and correlate it, and require valid unique positive committed tags before Applied.
Poll pending native outcomes and project terminal per-child command-dispatch events into current_frame_delta_.
Drain commands before planning the state update and flush the accumulated delta later in the same frame.

facts.statement: A found native result is not Applied unless its frozen result bytes decode, correlate to the exact request identity, report Committed and supply one valid unique native tag per child.

The source forms a command-to-native-result-to-frame-delta route, but source structure alone does not prove that the candidate engine callbacks execute atomically in a real game or that a broker consumes every emitted child outcome.

open_questions: Does controlled native Count1/2/4 qualification observe every correlated child tag and physical product without a partial replacement?
The actively changing FSBar candidate is intentionally absent; which exact protected broker revision will consume these historical-candidate outcomes?
